name: the-worst-shomii
description: The Worst Shomii — Levanter WhatsApp bot deployment

SESSION_ID.description: Your Levanter session ID. Keep it private.

SUDO.description: Admin number(s), as required by the bot source

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Exact Heroku app name chosen during deployment (not the display title). Needed for Levanter platform detection.

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Your own Heroku account API key. Needed by this Levanter version for Heroku platform detection and optional app-management features. Keep private; never reuse the repository owner's key.

KOYEB.description: Set true only when running on Koyeb; otherwise leave false.

KOYEB_NAME.description: Koyeb service name, if using Koyeb.

KOYEB_API.description: Koyeb API key, if using Koyeb; keep private.

VPS.description: Set true only when running on a VPS; leave false for Heroku.
